name: Logomania
summary: Accessories that carry a brand mark on the whole surface. Examples are a monogram repeat on coated canvas, large metal letters on a belt and a logo on a scarf. The mark is the design, and it shows status.

philosophy.core_thesis: The mark of the maker is the ornament, and the wearer shows a place in the world by it.
design_principles: Repeat the mark across the whole surface in rows, 2 to 4 cm tall.
Print or weave the mark in a tone that contrasts with the ground.
Use a coated canvas that shows the print and wears well.
Set a large metal letter or a double mark as a buckle or a clasp, 4 to 8 cm wide.
Carry the mark from the bag to the belt, the wallet and the scarf, so that the set matches.
Keep the leather trim in a plain tan or black to frame the print.
Place the mark so that it reads at a distance of 5 m.
Make a copy, a remix or a custom piece in the same logic, in the street.
anti_patterns: A small, hidden logo on the inside

silhouette.shape: A simple bag, belt or scarf shape that serves as a field for the mark.
silhouette.line: A clean outline, so that the pattern reads: a rectangular tote, a square scarf, a wide belt.
silhouette.fit: The item is worn in view: on the arm, at the waist or round the neck.
silhouette.proportion: Mark repeat 2–4 cm tall; belt buckle letter 4–8 cm; tote 35–45 cm wide; scarf 90 cm square.
rules: Fill the whole face with the repeat, and run it on the seams.
Pick a mark that is known at a glance, and show it big.
Bind the edges in plain leather in a warm tone.
Fit the hardware in gilt metal and engrave the mark on it.

fabrics.rule: Use a surface that holds a printed or woven repeat: coated canvas, PVC cloth or jacquard, with leather at the edges.

methods: coated canvas cut and matched on the repeat
construction.closures: A zip with a metal pull in the shape of the mark, a turn-lock or a large letter buckle.
construction.details: The mark on the clasp, a leather tab with the name, a bold stripe on the strap and a matching lining.

surface.pattern: A monogram or a double letter, repeated in rows with an offset; sometimes a stripe or a check beside it.
surface.gloss: Coated canvas at 20–40 GU; gilt letters at 80–90 GU; patent leather at 85–100 GU.
surface.wear: The surface wears well: the coating hides scuffs, and the print stays; a fake or a remix is part of the style's life.

palette.strategy: A brown, tan or black ground with a mark in a tone on tone or in a bold contrast, and a gilt metal.

making.scale: Houses made the mark in large series for sale in shops; custom ateliers in the street remade the marks on leather and on clothing.
making.signs: A mark that is matched at the seams, a clear print and an engraved metal piece.

pieces.form: Tote in coated canvas with an all-over monogram repeat
Shoulder bag in PVC cloth with a printed double mark
Wide belt with a large metal letter buckle
Silk scarf printed with a repeat of the house letters

evidence.title: Camp - Notes on Fashion at the Met - Gucci and Louis Vuitton (73828).jpg

emotion.target_response: A sense of status and of membership: the viewer reads the mark at once, and it names a place in the world.

use_cases: a fashion image prompt with a 1990s status look
a brief for a logo repeat on leather goods
a study of brand marks in dress
a street-fashion collection with custom logo prints
avoid_when: the brief wants a quiet, unmarked object
the brief is a craft or heritage piece with no brand

modifiers.how: Take the mark off, keep the shape and the leather, and match the tone of the leather to the cloth.

modifiers.request: as a bag of the season
modifiers.how: Drop the repeat, make a single new shape in a bold material and name it after a season.

ornament_level.note: The mark covers the whole surface; a quiet version keeps one letter on the clasp.
